description: A finite signed ground literal problem is satisfiable if and only if it has neither an equality conflict nor an opposite-sign relation conflict.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.hasModel_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Problem L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.HasModel Γ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.ConflictFree Γ
